notes: Two isnads open the report («وَحَدَّثَنا الْحاكِم» begins the second), each with the same saying (the reasons of the Law), so two groups
«عَن عَمِّهِ أَبي عَبْدِ اَللَّه مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شاذان» : «عمه» plus a name is one link (rule 7)

Owner ruling 2: the Imam named in Fadl's words (the source of his reasons) is the last link, imam_in_text; the first occurrence sits in the closing question-and-answer, the second in the final sentence
The closing restates the chain of the first group before the question-and-answer; it is not a third group
«قالَ مُصَنِّفُ هذا الْكِتاب» is the compiler's remark and is not a link (rule 13)
